name: agentic-awesome-skills
description: AAS Core is the local, agent-first control plane for complete catalog discovery, agent-owned selection, stack validation, and planning, backed by 2,600+ agentic skills. Includes CLI, local MCP, catalog, plugins, and Workbench.
one_liner: A searchable local library and control panel of over 2,600 pre-written 'skill' playbooks that AI coding agents can pick from, so you don't have to write agent instructions from scratch.
buyer: Mainly other developers building agent tooling — this is infrastructure for people already deep in the AI-coding-agent ecosystem, not a general business buyer.
business_use_cases: An AI tooling team uses it to discover and vet reusable skills instead of reinventing agent instructions for every new project.
A dev tools vendor integrates the catalog into their own product as a built-in skill marketplace.
A consultant curates and recommends a vetted subset of the catalog for clients adopting agent-based workflows, as a paid advisory add-on.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid curation/advisory: pick and configure the right 20 skills out of 2,600+ for a specific client's stack.

steal_this: This is dev infrastructure, not a product most businesses would pay for directly — if you want to use it, the honest weekend project is curating a tiny vetted subset for your own stack, not trying to sell the catalog itself.
